verdict.reasoning_rule: For agreements using commit-pinned delivery terms, validators should prioritize authenticated source facts over self-descriptive web pages. Verified proof must establish: (1) repository identity matches the agreed repository, (2) the full immutable commit SHA matches, and (3) the delivery scope or exact changed files match the committed acceptance criteria. If those elements are verified by the source adapter, delivery is satisfied absent contrary verified evidence. Deployment artifacts can corroborate availability, but unstable or merely declarative deployment evidence cannot substitute for repository-authenticated proof.
